name: open-links
description: A Claude Code mod: file paths in Claude's replies become links that open the file (or your editor at the line). macOS, Linux and Windows paths, relative ones resolved against the session folder.

editor.title: Editor command
editor.description: Open files with this command instead of the default app, at the line when the path has one (code, cursor, windsurf: anything that takes -g file:line). Empty: the default app.

skipPlanning.title: Leave .planning markdown to gsd-status-mod
skipPlanning.description: Skip markdown files under .planning, which gsd-status-mod already links to its reader.

roots.title: Extra folders
roots.description: Folders to resolve relative paths against when they are not in the session folder, separated by ; (open-links also learns the folders this session's tools worked in).
